about_the_game:
"Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad Demo" is a fast-paced, challenging roguelike turn-based strategy game that will completely change your expectations of traditional turn-based combat!

The content included in the demo version: 3 playable characters, 3 sets of character-exclusive rune cards and common rune cards, level design for the first chapter, monster design, and boss challenges.

Game Features:

🌀 Turn-Based ≠ Static Combat, Positioning is Key to Victory!
Predict enemy moves, position yourself carefully to dodge deadly attacks, and seize the right moment for a counterattack! One wrong step can cost you everything; one clever move can turn the tide in an instant!

💥 Skill Timing and Positioning Lead to Tactical Domination!
Use movement to control the battlefield, push enemies into deadly traps, or even make them turn on each other—experience an unprecedented strategic thrill!

🎴 Roguelike Gameplay, Customize Your Combat Style!
Randomly dropped battle cards from encounters and shops not only enhance your stats but also alter your abilities! Every adventure offers a unique combat experience!

🏕️ From Ruins to Base: Build Beyond the Adventure!
Don’t rush to rest after your adventure—your base is where true growth happens! Use resources to unlock buildings and systems, upgrade your camp, and develop functions to create your perfect adventurer's home!

🍻 Recruit, Train, and Strengthen Your Reckless Squad!
Meet new allies with special skills, create the ultimate lineup, and train them in the arena to prepare for even more dangerous explorations!

💀 Death is Not the End, It's the Start of Your Growth!
Every failure is a stepping stone to victory! Unlock new characters, cards, and buildings to keep evolving your team and become stronger with each battle!

🌪️ Endless Challenges Await, The True Adventure Has Just Begun!
Finishing the game is just the beginning—higher difficulties, tougher enemies, and more treacherous environments are waiting for you to conquer!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 630 or AMD Radeon HD 7450
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: "Fadedlands: The Reckless Squad Demo" is a tactical turn-based game with real-time strategy elements. Lead the Reckless Squad into the forest to uncover the mystery of the prince’s disappearance. With roguelike features, each run offers fresh challenges and surprises!
